item.title: train ambush: nausicaä
item.description: During the June heatwave, I took an 8-hour train that was thankfully air-conditioned, on time, and very comfortable—thanks České dráhy! The first half of that fiery, disgusting day had sucked me dry of any hint of energy (for an accurate visual representation, I refer readers to an iconic Indian TV ad from maybe the 2000s). And there was a huge group of teenagers just in front of me, so I needed to be properly distracted in order to keep the already-twitching crankiness dial under control. So, I scrolled the usual apps for something to watch: something engrossing, but light and not very demanding. Netflix seemed to have a lot of the Miyazaki x Ghibli movies—I’m a fan, but I haven’t watched them all. I landed on Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind.
